title: A New Podcast From The Times: First Person

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯汀·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在NYTimes.com上直播部分采访内容，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: Today, we're going to do something a little different.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要尝试一些不同的内容。

sentences.en: I want to tell you about a new podcast from the Opinion Desk of the Times called First Person.
sentences.zh: 我想向大家介绍《纽约时报》评论部推出的一档新播客，名为《第一人称》（First Person）。

sentences.en: Every week, host Lulu Garcia Navarro talks to people whose lives intersect with the news and brings us the personal stories behind their beliefs.
sentences.zh: 每周，主持人露露·加西亚·纳瓦罗都会与那些生活与新闻产生交集的人交谈，并为我们带来他们信仰背后的个人故事。

sentences.en: It feels like a way that people don't always hear from each other these days, especially people they might disagree with.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是一种人们如今并不总是能听到的交流方式，尤其是与那些他们可能持不同意见的人之间的交流。

sentences.en: In the latest episode, Lulu looks at the origins of one of the country's most powerful movements, parental rights.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期节目中，露露审视了美国最强大的运动之一——家长权利运动的起源。

sentences.en: Think parents up in arms at school board meetings, mad about books in the school library or what their kids are being taught.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，家长们在学校董事会会议上义愤填膺，对学校图书馆里的书或孩子们被教导的内容感到愤怒。

sentences.en: Lulu speaks with one of the movement's key leaders about why its appeal and influence have never been greater.
sentences.zh: 露露采访了该运动的一位关键领导人，探讨了为什么它的吸引力和影响力从未像现在这样巨大。

sentences.en: It's exactly the kind of conversation that Lulu has on first person every week.
sentences.zh: 这正是露露每周在《第一人称》节目中进行的对话类型。

sentences.en: So we're going to turn our show over to them.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们要把我们的节目交给他们。

sentences.en: Here it is.
sentences.zh: 节目开始。

sentences.en: Florida, Utah, Indiana, Missouri.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州、犹他州、印第安纳州、密苏里州。

sentences.en: This year alone, 82 bills in 26 states have been introduced under the banner of parents' rights.
sentences.zh: 仅今年一年，就有26个州提出了82项以“家长权利”为旗号的法案。

sentences.en: By now, most people are familiar with this version of the story.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，大多数人都熟悉这个故事的版本。

sentences.en: Angry parents descending on school board meetings in places like Loudoun County, Virginia.
sentences.zh: 愤怒的家长们涌向弗吉尼亚州劳登县等地举行的学校董事会会议。

sentences.en: The election of that state's Republican governor, Glenn Youngkin, who capitalized on the political
sentences.zh: 该州共和党州长格伦·扬金的当选，他利用了这种政治

sentences.en: momentum and the growing recognition by conservative groups, the parental rights could be a powerful rallying cry.
sentences.zh: 势头，以及保守派团体日益认识到“家长权利”可能成为一种强大的号召口号。

sentences.en: And that was especially true for Will Estrada.
sentences.zh: 对于威尔·埃斯特拉达来说，情况尤其如此。

sentences.en: He's the newly appointed head of parentalrights.org.
sentences.zh: 他是新任命的ParentalRights.org负责人。

sentences.en: That's a group that has spearheaded many of the bills now being passed around conservative state houses, which often focus on what and how children learn in schools.
sentences.zh: 该组织带头推动了许多目前在保守派州议会中通过的法案，这些法案通常关注孩子们在学校学习什么以及如何学习。

sentences.en: But the more I learned about Will, the more I realized that the story of his life is a story about where parental rights really comes from, far away from the public school system.
sentences.zh: 但我对威尔了解得越多，就越意识到他的人生故事其实就是关于“家长权利”真正起源的故事，它远离公立学校系统。

sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia Navarro, and this is First Person from New York Times Opinion.
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚·纳瓦罗，这是来自《纽约时报》评论部的《第一人称》。

sentences.en: Today, Will Estrada and the long roots of parental rights.
sentences.zh: 今天的主题是威尔·埃斯特拉达与“家长权利”的深远根源。

sentences.en: Will, to start, I want to understand what your own educational background was growing up.
sentences.zh: 威尔，首先，我想了解一下你成长过程中的教育背景。

sentences.en: Can you tell me about your family, the house you grew up in?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我说说你的家庭，你长大的房子吗？

sentences.en: What did your parents do?
sentences.zh: 你的父母是做什么的？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So my dad is Puerto Rican and grew up in the Bronx.
sentences.zh: 我父亲是波多黎各人，在布朗克斯长大。

sentences.en: My mom is the granddaughter of Italian immigrants.
sentences.zh: 我母亲是意大利移民的孙女。

sentences.en: We lived in rural northern Pennsylvania, Bradford County.
sentences.zh: 我们住在宾夕法尼亚州北部的农村，布拉德福德县。

sentences.en: Sometimes we would have snowstorms come through and, you know, you wouldn't see a plow for three or four days.
sentences.zh: 有时我们会遇到暴风雪，你知道，三四天都看不到扫雪机。

sentences.en: Dad would just kind of cross over the New York border.
sentences.zh: 父亲会越过纽约州的边界。

sentences.en: He would work as a public school teacher for the state of New York.
sentences.zh: 他在纽约州担任公立学校教师。

sentences.en: And mom stayed home.
sentences.zh: 母亲则待在家里。

sentences.en: She gave up a career in IBM.
sentences.zh: 她放弃了在IBM的职业生涯。

sentences.en: She was actually working on some of the precursors of today's internet at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时她实际上正在从事一些现代互联网前身的工作。

sentences.en: And she stayed home.
sentences.zh: 她留在了家里。

sentences.en: She raised the eight of us kids.
sentences.zh: 她抚养了我们八个孩子。

sentences.en: I'm the oldest of eight.
sentences.zh: 我是八个孩子中的老大。

sentences.en: There were five boys, three girls in my family.
sentences.zh: 家里有五个男孩，三个女孩。

sentences.en: And she did the bulk of the homeschooling.
sentences.zh: 大部分的家庭教育都是由她完成的。

sentences.en: Then dad would get home from work and he would help out with it as well.
sentences.zh: 父亲下班回家后也会帮忙。

sentences.en: So we were homeschooled K through 12, all of us.
sentences.zh: 所以我们从幼儿园到12年级都是在家接受教育的，我们所有人都是。

sentences.en: I remember the grandparents were not huge fans of it at the time.
sentences.zh: 我记得祖父母当时并不是很喜欢这种方式。

sentences.en: But the interesting thing was...
sentences.zh: 但有趣的是……

sentences.en: What was their...
sentences.zh: 他们当时……

sentences.en: Let me just stay with that for a second.
sentences.zh: 让我先停在这里一下。

sentences.en: Why were they hostile to it?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么对此有敌意？

sentences.en: What were their concerns back then?
sentences.zh: 他们当时有什么顾虑？

sentences.en: I think they felt that we would not get a good education.
sentences.zh: 我想他们觉得我们无法获得良好的教育。

sentences.en: The view of homeschooling at the time was you're not going to be prepared for the jobs of tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 当时对家庭教育的看法是：你将无法为未来的工作做好准备。

sentences.en: And you're going to...
sentences.zh: 而且你会……

sentences.en: I think the thought was you'll come up blinking in the sunlight out of the basement in the slime.
sentences.zh: 我想他们的想法是，你会像从地下室爬出来的生物一样，在阳光下眨着眼，显得很滑稽。

sentences.en: And it's a subpar education.
sentences.zh: 而且这是一种次等的教育。

sentences.en: I am really interested in the fact that your father was a public school teacher.
sentences.zh: 我非常感兴趣的一点是，你的父亲是一名公立学校教师。

sentences.en: As someone who chose a career in the public school system, what's your understanding of why he wanted his own children to be homeschooled?
sentences.zh: 作为一名选择在公立学校系统工作的人，你是如何理解他为什么希望自己的孩子在家接受教育的？

sentences.en: So I kind of have to back up.
sentences.zh: 我得先回顾一下。

sentences.en: We grew up in a Christian household and dad was passionate and is passionate about public education, but he was even more so passionate about his faith.
sentences.zh: 我们在一个基督教家庭长大，父亲热爱公立教育，但他更热爱他的信仰。

sentences.en: And one of the things that was very important to my parents was living out their faith as well.
sentences.zh: 我父母非常看重的一点就是践行他们的信仰。

sentences.en: And so homeschooling was kind of just becoming more common at the time, the late 80s, early 1980s.
sentences.zh: 所以家庭教育在当时，也就是80年代末、80年代初，开始变得越来越普遍。

sentences.en: It was still illegal in some portions of the country, but my parents said, this is a way that we can really teach our
sentences.zh: 在全国某些地区这仍然是非法的，但我父母说，这是一种我们可以真正教导我们的

sentences.en: children a holistic worldview, studying math, studying science, studying history, but also at the same time, studying the Bible and studying scriptures.
sentences.zh: 孩子拥有整体世界观的方式，学习数学、科学、历史，但同时也要学习圣经和经文。

sentences.en: And so they started off homeschooling.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始了家庭教育。

sentences.en: There were definitely tensions.
sentences.zh: 这中间肯定存在张力。

sentences.en: I remember sometimes when my dad would come home and say, yeah, my coworkers are mad at me that we're homeschooling.
sentences.zh: 我记得有时父亲回家会说，是的，我的同事们因为我们在做家庭教育而对我感到生气。

sentences.en: And they think, well, what kind of public school teacher are you?
sentences.zh: 他们会想，你算是什么样的公立学校老师？

sentences.en: So especially in the early years of homeschooling, there was still a lot of fear.
sentences.zh: 所以在家庭教育的早期，确实存在很多恐惧。

sentences.en: About what?
sentences.zh: 关于什么？

sentences.en: I think about the legal status, about, you know, could a government official come in and say, no, you can't homeschool.
sentences.zh: 我想是关于法律地位，关于，你知道，政府官员会不会进来，说“不，你不能在家教育孩子”。

sentences.en: This is not best interest of the child, or this is not a legal right.
sentences.zh: “这不符合孩子的最大利益”，或者“这不是一项合法权利”。

sentences.en: You've got to enroll your children in public school.
sentences.zh: “你必须让你的孩子去公立学校注册”。

sentences.en: And I remember my parents saying things such as, you know, if ever a social worker comes to the door or a truant officer comes to the door,
sentences.zh: 我记得我父母会说这样的话，比如，如果社会工作者或逃学官员敲门，

sentences.en: just say, I have Fourth Amendment rights and Mike Ferris is my lawyer.
sentences.zh: 就说：我有宪法第四修正案赋予的权利，迈克·费里斯是我的律师。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: Mike Ferris is an influential conservative lawyer and the founder of the Homeschool Legal Defense
sentences.zh: 迈克·费里斯是一位有影响力的保守派律师，也是家庭教育法律辩护

sentences.en: Association.
sentences.zh: 协会的创始人。

sentences.en: And for families like Wills, he was kind of a legend.
sentences.zh: 对于像威尔这样的家庭来说，他简直是个传奇人物。

sentences.en: Because this group he'd created, it was built on the idea that not only was homeschooling a legal right, it was a constitutionally protected one.
sentences.zh: 因为他创立的这个组织建立在一个理念之上：家庭教育不仅是一项合法权利，而且是受宪法保护的权利。

sentences.en: And the HSLDA was there to defend that.
sentences.zh: 而HSLDA的存在就是为了捍卫这一点。

sentences.en: HSLDA is the only legal advocate for homeschooling with an office in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: HSLDA是唯一在华盛顿特区设有办事处的家庭教育法律倡导机构。

sentences.en: From there, they actively monitor each piece of legislation pertaining to your rights to homeschool at both the federal and the state level.
sentences.zh: 从那里，他们积极监督每一项与您家庭教育权利相关的联邦和州级立法。

sentences.en: They then decide whether to support or oppose the legislation.
sentences.zh: 然后他们决定是支持还是反对这些立法。

sentences.en: Now, if you're currently homeschooling, you're relying on one or both pillars that make homeschooling legal.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果您正在进行家庭教育，您所依赖的是使家庭教育合法化的两大支柱之一。

sentences.en: Either your right to choose what's best for your child or your right to religious freedom.
sentences.zh: 要么是你选择最适合孩子教育方式的权利，要么是你的宗教自由权利。

sentences.en: But if either of these rights is compromised, homeschooling falls.
sentences.zh: 但如果这两项权利中的任何一项受到损害，家庭教育就会崩塌。

sentences.en: With the help of its members, HSLDA fights hard for your right to homeschool.
sentences.zh: 在成员的帮助下，HSLDA会为您的家庭教育权利进行坚决斗争。

sentences.en: Join HSLDA to protect your freedom,
sentences.zh: 加入HSLDA，保护您的自由、

sentences.en: your family, and your future.
sentences.zh: 您的家庭和您的未来。

sentences.en: So homeschool legal defense kind of grew on, especially for the early generation of homeschoolers,
sentences.zh: 所以家庭教育法律辩护协会在某种程度上成长起来了，特别是对于早期的一代家庭教育者来说，

sentences.en: almost this larger than life, sort of like the ACLU is when it comes to civil liberties or free speech of homeschool legal defenses there.
sentences.zh: 它几乎就像是民权自由联盟（ACLU）在公民自由或言论自由方面的地位一样，家庭教育法律辩护协会就在那里。

sentences.en: They will take a case to the Supreme Court if they need to.
sentences.zh: 如果需要，他们会把案件打到最高法院。

sentences.en: They are our lawyers.
sentences.zh: 他们是我们的律师。

sentences.en: And I remember a few times my mom would call them just to ask basic questions.
sentences.zh: 我记得我母亲有几次打电话给他们，只是为了问一些基本问题。

sentences.en: And she'd be like, I talked to one of the lawyers at homeschool legal defense.
sentences.zh: 她会说，我和家庭教育法律辩护协会的一位律师谈过了。

sentences.en: And so kind of growing up, it was this, this, almost this mythos of the Olympus that, that was there for the homeschool community, for parents, for families.
sentences.zh: 所以成长过程中，这几乎是一种奥林匹斯山的神话，它就在那里，为了家庭教育社区，为了家长，为了家庭。

sentences.en: And-
sentences.zh: 而且——

sentences.en: Will remembers that his family had the HSLDA's phone number pinned to their fridge growing up.
sentences.zh: 威尔记得他小时候家里把HSLDA的电话号码贴在冰箱上。

sentences.en: And it was partly because of this reverence for the group that Will says he knew from a very young age that he wanted to be a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 正是因为对该组织的这种崇敬，威尔说他很小的时候就知道自己想成为一名律师。

sentences.en: He remembers listening to Supreme Court confirmation hearings with his dad growing up.
sentences.zh: 他记得小时候和父亲一起听最高法院的确认听证会。

sentences.en: And when it came time to go to college, Will won scholarships and got into an Ivy League school.
sentences.zh: 当到了上大学的时候，威尔赢得了奖学金并进入了一所常春藤盟校。

sentences.en: But he decided instead to go to Oak Brook College of Law, a school that describes itself as providing, quote, a legal education from a biblical and historical perspective.
sentences.zh: 但他决定去奥克布鲁克法学院（Oak Brook College of Law），这是一所自称提供“从圣经和历史角度进行法律教育”的学校。

sentences.en: It was a Christian law school.
sentences.zh: 那是一所基督教法学院。

sentences.en: Students can do an online course.
sentences.zh: 学生可以参加在线课程。

sentences.en: Back then we had the tape, you know, the cassette tapes, and I would have my Walkman and be taking care of our sheep,
sentences.zh: 那时我们有磁带，你知道，卡式磁带，我会戴着随身听，一边照顾我们的羊，

sentences.en: still living at home actually at the time, and listening to my audio lectures.
sentences.zh: 当时其实还住在家里，一边听我的音频讲座。

sentences.en: And I would mail in my assignments.
sentences.zh: 然后我会把作业寄过去。

sentences.en: We'd have video lectures.
sentences.zh: 我们会有视频讲座。

sentences.en: So just to be clear, Oak Brook was an entirely online education back in the early 2000s.
sentences.zh: 所以明确一下，奥克布鲁克在21世纪初完全是线上教育。

sentences.en: You did all of this from your parents' home?
sentences.zh: 你所有的学习都是在父母家里完成的？

sentences.en: Mostly.
sentences.zh: 大部分是。

sentences.en: So we'd do a week every year on campus.
sentences.zh: 我们每年会在校园里待一周。

sentences.en: We'd fly out.
sentences.zh: 我们会飞过去。

sentences.en: We'd meet the professors.
sentences.zh: 我们会见到教授。

sentences.en: But then after that one week, it was all entirely online.
sentences.zh: 但那一周之后，就完全是在线进行了。

sentences.en: So yeah, for the first two years, I was still living at home.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，前两年我还是住在家里。

sentences.en: So is it correct to say you've been in approximately about two weeks of in-person school in your life?
sentences.zh: 那么说你一生中大约只在学校里待过两周，这准确吗？

sentences.en: You know, that's accurate.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这很准确。

sentences.en: When you put it that way, yes, that is true.
sentences.zh: 当你这样说的时候，是的，那是真的。

sentences.en: When you look at the trajectory of Will's life, it continues along this pretty straight line.
sentences.zh: 当你审视威尔的人生轨迹时，它沿着这条相当直的线继续发展。

sentences.en: While he's still at Oak Brook, he applies for a job as a paralegal at the HSLDA.
sentences.zh: 当他还在奥克布鲁克时，他申请了HSLDA的律师助理职位。

sentences.en: He spends a few years doing that with a bunch of like-minded young people.
sentences.zh: 他花了几年的时间与一群志同道合的年轻人一起工作。

sentences.en: He actually meets his wife there.
sentences.zh: 他实际上是在那里遇到了他的妻子。

sentences.en: Then a big job opens up to be the HSLDA's top lobbyist on Capitol Hill, trying to block any kind of oversight of homeschooling from being passed.
sentences.zh: 然后出现了一个重要的职位空缺，担任HSLDA在国会山的高级游说者，试图阻止任何形式的家庭教育监管法案通过。

sentences.en: And the group decides to take a chance on Will.

sentences.zh: 突然之间，数百万美国家庭不得不处理他们孩子的教育问题。

sentences.en: They're getting this window into how their children are being educated.
sentences.zh: 你什么时候意识到这可能具有政治推动力，即我毕生致力于的“父母权利”这一事业，正成为越来越多的人开始关心的事情？

sentences.en: When did you realize this might have some political juice, that this thing that I devoted my career to,
sentences.zh: 2018年3月，我离开了在家教育法律辩护处。

sentences.en: parental rights, is this thing that a lot more people are starting to care about?
sentences.zh: 那是我一直梦想工作的地方。

sentences.en: So, Lulu, it was a little slow for me.
sentences.zh: 我热爱我在那里的岁月。

sentences.en: So in March of 2018, I left homeschool legal defense.
sentences.zh: 但我当时一时兴起，申请了美国卫生与公众服务部民权办公室的一个联邦职业职位。

sentences.en: This was the place I'd always dreamed of working.
sentences.zh: 我被我们居住的弗吉尼亚州录取了。

sentences.en: I loved my years there.
sentences.zh: 我们住在劳登县，那里有非常好的学校系统，尽管最近它因激烈的校董会会议而闻名。

sentences.en: But I had applied for, kind of on a whim, a career federal position in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而且因为我们在进行在家教育，我们算是置身事外。

sentences.en: Department of Health and Human Services in the Office for Civil Rights.
sentences.zh: 这就是全部内容了。

sentences.en: And I'd been accepted in Virginia, where we live.
sentences.zh: 我们对此感到很庆幸。

sentences.en: We live in
sentences.zh: 因为我们不用担心这些。

sentences.en: Loudoun County, which has really good school systems, although lately it's become known for contentious school board meetings.
sentences.zh: 所以这很有趣。

sentences.en: And because we were homeschooling, we were kind of outside of this.
sentences.zh: 这确实很有趣。

sentences.en: And so it started to kind of trickle through as I'm scrolling through Twitter and as I'm seeing things on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 随着我刷着推特，看着脸书上的内容，这种情绪开始慢慢渗透出来。

sentences.en: I'm struggling with re-enrolling my kids in Loudoun County Public
sentences.zh: 我当时正为给孩子们重新在劳登县公立

sentences.en: School.
sentences.zh: 学校注册入学而苦恼。

sentences.en: People who I had known, who I thought were the most laid-back, non-political people ever,
sentences.zh: 那些我认识的，我原以为最随和、最不关心政治的人，

sentences.en: all of a sudden they're talking about school board issues and sharing videos of school boards.
sentences.zh: 突然间都在谈论学校董事会的问题，并转发有关校董会的视频。

sentences.en: Once again, the school board has proven itself to be an abject failure.
sentences.zh: 校董会再次证明了自己是一个彻头彻尾的失败者。

sentences.en: And I'm just seeing so many of our friends sharing Facebook posts and really getting upset.
sentences.zh: 我看到太多的朋友在转发脸书帖子，而且真的感到非常愤怒。

sentences.en: I'm done being frustrated, shocked, disrespected, and unheard.
sentences.zh: 我受够了这种沮丧、震惊、不被尊重和无人倾听的感觉。

sentences.en: And they're coming and speaking at school board meetings and they're passing recall petitions for school board members.
sentences.zh: 他们开始在校董会会议上发言，并为罢免校董会成员发起请愿。

sentences.en: I am here to tell you that there is a movement of parents who will never be stopped, never be silenced.
sentences.zh: 我在这里告诉你们，有一场家长运动，他们永远不会被阻止，永远不会被噤声。

sentences.en: So I'm like, I guess there's something that's happening here.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时想，看来这里确实发生了一些事情。

sentences.en: And it was, I think, eye-opening in a way that I don't think we would have seen otherwise if it had not been for the
sentences.zh: 我认为这在某种程度上让人大开眼界，如果不是因为

sentences.en: pandemic and for the virtual schooling that the public schools switched to.
sentences.zh: 疫情以及公立学校转向虚拟教学，我们恐怕不会看到这一点。

sentences.en: We would not have seen it become so nationwide and parents so fired up about what's going on with their school.
sentences.zh: 我们不会看到它变得如此全国化，也不会看到家长们对学校发生的事情如此激动。

sentences.en: Parents, would you really want father government to have the last say about what happens in schools?
sentences.zh: 家长们，你们真的希望“政府爸爸”对学校发生的事情拥有最终决定权吗？

sentences.en: Would you be fine with your child leaving a social-emotional learning lesson about white-ism?
sentences.zh: 如果你的孩子在上一堂关于“白人主义”的社会情感学习课，你会觉得没问题吗？

sentences.en: There should be no sexually explicit material available in school libraries.
sentences.zh: 学校图书馆不应提供任何露骨的性材料。

sentences.en: I'm totally opposed to the vaccine mandate for athletes and students.
sentences.zh: 我完全反对针对运动员和学生的疫苗强制令。

sentences.en: It's a violation of medical privacy.
sentences.zh: 这是对医疗隐私的侵犯。

sentences.en: The board will now take a five-minute recess.
sentences.zh: 董事会现在休会五分钟。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Did we hurt your feelings?
sentences.zh: 我们伤到你的自尊了吗？

sentences.en: So maybe you're a little slow to see this, but once you do, does that feel like a clear opportunity to you to suddenly see, as you say, so many non-political people being activated
sentences.zh: 也许你反应慢了点才发现这一点，但一旦你发现了，这是否让你觉得是一个绝佳的机会，突然看到你所说的那么多非政治人士

sentences.en: around parenting?
sentences.zh: 围绕育儿问题被激活了？

sentences.en: Obviously, your history is one of recognizing the political power of parents and children in fighting these fights.
sentences.zh: 显然，你的过往经历就是认识到家长和孩子在这些斗争中的政治力量。

sentences.en: You know, I would like to say that, yes, I realized it, but really, I can't say that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我真想说，是的，我意识到了，但说实话，我不能这么说。

sentences.en: It wasn't really until the Glenn Youngkin-Terry McAuliffe race here in Virginia.
sentences.zh: 直到弗吉尼亚州格伦·杨金（Glenn Youngkin）和特里·麦考利夫（Terry McAuliffe）的竞选时才真正意识到。

sentences.en: That was the governor's race here in 2021.
sentences.zh: 那是2021年这里的州长竞选。

sentences.en: The race, a dead heat between Republican Glenn Youngkin and Democrat Terry McAuliffe.
sentences.zh: 那场竞选，共和党人格伦·杨金和民主党人特里·麦考利夫之间势均力敌。

sentences.en: And education is at the top of voters' minds.
sentences.zh: 而教育是选民最关心的问题。

sentences.en: Parents should have a say in what is taught in schools.
sentences.zh: 家长应该在学校教什么的问题上有发言权。

sentences.en: Schools.
sentences.zh: 学校。

sentences.en: I don't think parents should be telling schools what they should teach.
sentences.zh: 我不认为家长应该告诉学校他们应该教什么。

sentences.en: I'm not going to let parents come into schools and actually take books out and make their own decision.
sentences.zh: 我不会让家长进入学校，随意把书拿走并做出他们自己的决定。

sentences.en: I'd been involved in politics here in Virginia when I was at homeschool legal defense, and I thought, no, Virginia's a blue state.
sentences.zh: 我在家庭学校法律辩护协会（HSLDA）工作时就参与过弗吉尼亚州的政治，我当时想，不，弗吉尼亚州是个蓝州。

sentences.en: It's gone the way of Colorado.
sentences.zh: 它已经变得像科罗拉多州一样了。

sentences.en: It's gone the way of California.
sentences.zh: 它已经变得像加利福尼亚州一样了。

sentences.en: It's gone the way of New York.
sentences.zh: 它已经变得像纽约州一样了。

sentences.en: It's never going to change.
sentences.zh: 它永远不会改变。

sentences.en: It is difficult in a state where a close election will be determined in the fast-growing northern
sentences.zh: 在一个势均力敌的选举结果将由快速增长的北部

sentences.en: Virginia suburbs, where you have a lot of parents and a lot of debate about critical race
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚郊区决定的州，那里有许多家长，关于批判性种族

sentences.en: theory, about what's being taught in schools, to have a candidate for governor say, I don't want to listen to parents.
sentences.zh: 理论、关于学校教学内容的争论非常激烈，让州长候选人说“我不想听家长的意见”是很难的。

sentences.en: Then the election hits, and I was floored, Lulu.
sentences.zh: 然后选举结果出来了，我惊呆了，露露（Lulu）。

sentences.en: I said, you know, people who voted for
sentences.zh: 我说，你知道，那些投票给

sentences.en: Joe Biden, less than 365 days later, turned around and voted for Glenn Youngkin.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登的人，不到365天后，转过头来投票给了格伦·杨金。

sentences.en: Why did you vote for Youngkin?
sentences.zh: 你为什么投票给杨金？

sentences.en: One of the big things, obviously, recently is just education.
sentences.zh: 显然，最近的一大重点就是教育。

sentences.en: I've got a daughter in the 10th grade here in the public school system, so it was a big, big deal for me.
sentences.zh: 我在公立学校系统里有一个上十年级的女儿，所以这对我很重要，非常重要。

sentences.en: That was very important.
sentences.zh: 那非常重要。

sentences.en: ABC News projecting Republican Glenn Youngkin, who made education a central issue, has won.
sentences.zh: 美国广播公司新闻（ABC News）预测，将教育作为核心议题的共和党人格伦·杨金获胜。

sentences.en: To parents, I say we respect you, and we will empower you in the education of your children.
sentences.zh: 对家长们，我想说我们尊重你们，我们将赋予你们在子女教育方面的权力。

sentences.en: And then right after that, the chairman of the board of parentalrights.org called me,
sentences.zh: 就在那之后，parentalrights.org的董事会主席给我打了电话，

sentences.en: and he said, Will, I know you're enjoying being in the federal government, but I think Glenn Youngkin's race, this is a watershed moment when it comes to parental rights.
sentences.zh: 他说，威尔（Will），我知道你在联邦政府工作很开心，但我认为格伦·杨金的竞选，在家长权利方面是一个分水岭时刻。

sentences.en: When it comes to the issues you used to work on at Homeschool Legal Defense for so long, would you leave the federal government
sentences.zh: 关于你长期在家庭学校法律辩护协会从事的问题，你愿意离开联邦政府，

sentences.en: and come on and become the president of parentalrights.org?
sentences.zh: 加入并成为parentalrights.org的主席吗？

sentences.en: Parentalrights.org was also started by Michael Farris.
sentences.zh: Parentalrights.org也是由迈克尔·法里斯（Michael Farris）创办的。

sentences.en: Remember Will's childhood inspiration and the founder of the HSLDA.
sentences.zh: 还记得威尔童年的偶像和HSLDA的创始人吗？

sentences.en: In the intervening years, Farris had become an architect of the rights push against big signature issues like gay marriage and abortion, mounting legal battles
sentences.zh: 在随后的几年里，法里斯成为了反对同性婚姻和堕胎等重大标志性议题的权利推动者，发起了旨在

sentences.en: designed to end up at the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 最终诉诸最高法院的法律斗争。

sentences.en: Now suddenly, parents' rights was exploding as a cause.
sentences.zh: 现在突然间，家长权利作为一项事业正在爆发。

sentences.en: So the bat signal goes out again.
sentences.zh: 所以蝙蝠信号再次亮起。

sentences.en: You're being called back.
sentences.zh: 你被召回了。

sentences.en: It kind of all clicked at that moment when the chairman of the board called me, and it was like the bat signal.
sentences.zh: 当董事会主席给我打电话时，一切都豁然开朗了，就像蝙蝠信号一样。

sentences.en: I was like, you know what?
sentences.zh: 我当时想，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I loved my time working in HSLDA for homeschool freedom, but I'm ready to make that jump to kind of the bigger issue.
sentences.zh: 我热爱在HSLDA为家庭学校自由工作的时光，但我准备好跳出来去处理那个更大的议题了。

sentences.en: And so it was an easy decision for me.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说这是一个容易的决定。

sentences.en: I want to talk to you about this evolution because in this role, you're suddenly dealing with this ever-widening interpretation of parental rights.
sentences.zh: 我想和你谈谈这种演变，因为在这个角色中，你突然要处理这种不断扩大的家长权利解释。

sentences.en: It started, as you say, with parents' frustrations around remote schooling, but it quickly grew to include masks in schools, CRT, questions over
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，它始于家长对远程教学的挫败感，但很快就扩展到包括学校口罩令、批判性种族理论（CRT）、关于

sentences.en: curriculum, what students are learning, book bans, a big group that may have very little in common.
sentences.zh: 课程、学生学习内容、禁书等问题，这是一个可能几乎没有共同点的庞大群体。

sentences.en: And it's all under this banner of parental rights.
sentences.zh: 而这一切都打着家长权利的旗号。

sentences.en: I'm wondering, has this all been recognizable to you as parental rights?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，这一切在你看来都能被识别为家长权利吗？

sentences.en: You know, it has.
sentences.zh: 你知道，是的。

sentences.en: And part of the reason why I was willing to leave, you know, the federal government and retirement benefits and all that.
sentences.zh: 我愿意离开联邦政府、放弃退休福利等等，部分原因就在于此。

sentences.en: But part of the reason was when I started looking at it, when I saw the Yunkin win here in Virginia, the Republican win, I really realized this is a moment
sentences.zh: 但部分原因是我开始审视它时，当我看到杨金在弗吉尼亚州的胜利，那个共和党的胜利，我真的意识到这是一个时刻，

sentences.en: that I don't think we've seen in a very long time.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们已经很久没有见过了。

sentences.en: Now, it's hard to tell will it laSt. You never know when you're in a historical moment until, you know, years have gone by.
sentences.zh: 现在，很难说它会持续多久。当你身处历史时刻时，你永远不知道，直到多年过去。

sentences.en: But it really seems like it's different than we've seen in prior movements that have come and gone.
sentences.zh: 但它看起来确实与我们过去见过的来来去去的运动不同。

sentences.en: I've been amazed, Lulu, that Terry McAuliffe could have absolutely said in that debate with Glenn Yunkin, I absolutely agree with you, Glenn.
sentences.zh: 露露，我感到很惊讶，特里·麦考利夫本可以在与格伦·杨金的辩论中完全说：“我完全同意你的观点，格伦。”

sentences.en: Parental rights are important.
sentences.zh: “家长权利很重要。”

sentences.en: Every teacher will tell you they want the parents to be engaged.
sentences.zh: 每一位老师都会告诉你，他们希望家长参与进来。

sentences.en: But we have to be careful that parents don't make the Wild West in public schools.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须小心，不要让家长把公立学校变成无法无天的荒野西部。

sentences.en: And when we look at what's happening with parental rights, it's flooring me.
sentences.zh: 当我们审视家长权利正在发生的事情时，我感到震惊。

sentences.en: I'm just, my mind is blown that you just don't have politicians from both sides saying we're going to respect this and
sentences.zh: 我只是，我的大脑被震撼了，你竟然没有看到来自双方的政客说“我们将尊重这一点”，

sentences.en: then maybe nuance it in different ways instead of doubling down on this insane concept that parents shouldn't be involved in the education of their children.
sentences.zh: 然后也许以不同的方式进行细微调整，而不是加倍坚持这种疯狂的观念，即家长不应该参与子女的教育。

sentences.en: This would be so easy.
sentences.zh: 这本来会很容易。

sentences.en: I mean, this was free political advice I'm giving.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我这是在提供免费的政治建议。

sentences.en: This would be so easy for people to just do the Bill Clinton, I feel your pain.
sentences.zh: 这对人们来说太容易了，就像比尔·克林顿那样说“我感同身受”。

sentences.en: I understand it.
sentences.zh: “我理解这一点。”

sentences.en: I'm engaged in my children's education and then kind of, you know, nuanced different things.
sentences.zh: “我参与了我孩子的教育”，然后进行一些细微的调整。

sentences.en: But instead, we're seeing the opposite.
sentences.zh: 但相反，我们看到了相反的情况。

sentences.en: And I it it boggles my mind.
sentences.zh: 我，我感到非常困惑。

sentences.en: It's political malpractice.
sentences.zh: 这是政治渎职。

sentences.en: I think what I hear you saying is that you think Democrats are missing the opportunity to also embrace the parents rights movement, which you think is available to anyone.
sentences.zh: 我想我听到你说的是，你认为民主党人错失了拥抱家长权利运动的机会，你认为这个机会对任何人都是开放的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: You look at some of the surveys and Americans, even even those who identify as liberal leaning and identify as
sentences.zh: 你看看一些调查，美国人，即使是那些自认为是自由派倾向的人，自认为是

sentences.en: Democrat and certainly moderates and completely certainly Republicans.
sentences.zh: 民主党人，当然还有温和派，当然还有共和党人。

sentences.en: They view this as one party supports parental rights, the Republican Party, and one party opposes parental rights, the Democrat
sentences.zh: 他们认为这是一个政党支持家长权利，即共和党，而另一个政党反对家长权利，即民主党

sentences.en: Party.
sentences.zh: 党。

sentences.en: And that shouldn't be the case.
sentences.zh: 情况本不该如此。

sentences.en: Parental rights are a bipartisan issue.
sentences.zh: 家长权利是一个两党共同关心的问题。

sentences.en: And so I feel like the Democrat Party is missing a moment and it's going to hurt them.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉民主党错失了一个时刻，这将会伤害他们。

sentences.en: I don't disagree with you, but I want to dig in on this idea that parental rights are available to
sentences.zh: 我不反对你的观点，但我想要深入探讨这个观点，即家长权利对任何人都是开放的，

sentences.en: anyone and that there's any kind of unified version of what parents rights means at this point.
sentences.zh: 而且目前对于家长权利的含义是否存在某种统一的版本。

sentences.en: And I want to do that by looking at some of what's happening at the state level in the name of parental rights.
sentences.zh: 我想通过审视一些在州一级以家长权利名义发生的事情来做到这一点。

sentences.en: There's the Florida Parental Rights and Education Bill, which is being called the Don't Say Gay Bill by its opponents.
sentences.zh: 有佛罗里达州的《家长权利与教育法案》，其反对者称之为“不许说同性恋法案”（Don't Say Gay Bill）。

sentences.en: That forbids any mention of sexual orientation or gender identity in K-3 classes and in other grades in a, quote, manner that is not age appropriate.
sentences.zh: 该法案禁止在幼儿园到三年级的课堂以及其他年级中，以“不适合年龄的方式”提及性取向或性别认同。

sentences.en: And sort of regardless of how a person feels about initiatives like these, one thing I've really been
sentences.zh: 无论一个人对这类倡议有何感受，我一直在

sentences.en: wrestling to understand is how this fits into your definition of parental rights.
sentences.zh: 努力理解的一点是，这如何符合你对家长权利的定义。

sentences.en: Because earlier you said you approach this work from the perspective that the parent is the best protector of the child.
sentences.zh: 因为早些时候你说过，你从“家长是孩子最好的保护者”这一角度来处理这项工作。

sentences.en: For you, this is rooted in a parent's individual legal rights to make decisions on behalf of their children.
sentences.zh: 对你来说，这植根于家长代表子女做出决定的个人法律权利。

sentences.en: But that's not what we're talking about here, is it?
sentences.zh: 但我们在这里讨论的不是这个，对吧？

sentences.en: This is about some kind of larger community understanding about what is in the best interests of parents and children.
sentences.zh: 这是关于某种更广泛的社区理解，即什么是家长和孩子的最大利益。

sentences.en: You know, that's a great question.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: And let's talk about the Florida Bill.
sentences.zh: 让我们谈谈佛罗里达州的法案。

sentences.en: That's HB 1557, the Parents' Rights and Education Bill.
sentences.zh: 那是HB 1557法案，《家长权利与教育法案》。

sentences.en: I still struggle to see what the opposition is to it.
sentences.zh: 我仍然难以理解反对它的理由是什么。

sentences.en: So as I think you accurately conveyed that it does limit some of the sexual orientation, gender identity discussion in public school classrooms in K-3.
sentences.zh: 正如我认为你准确传达的那样，它确实限制了公立学校幼儿园到三年级课堂上的一些关于性取向、性别认同的讨论。

sentences.en: How much should public school teachers be talking to kindergarten through third grade students about sexual orientation and gender identity?
sentences.zh: 公立学校老师应该在多大程度上与幼儿园到三年级的学生谈论性取向和性别认同？

sentences.en: It's a legitimate question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个合理的问题。

sentences.en: I mean, it is a legitimate question, considering the fact that there are gay families, that transgender people do exist in the world, and that is simply,
sentences.zh: 我是说，考虑到世界上存在同性家庭、存在跨性别者，这确实是一个合理的问题，而且这仅仅是，

sentences.en: one could say, acknowledging reality.
sentences.zh: 有人可能会说，承认现实。

sentences.en: And I also want to say that also with the Florida Bill,
sentences.zh: 我也想说，关于佛罗里达州的法案，

sentences.en: I mean, the enforcement component is important because it opens the door to parents being able to sue school districts that they perceive to have violated this ban.
sentences.zh: 执行部分很重要，因为它为家长起诉他们认为违反了这一禁令的学区打开了大门。

sentences.en: And so it's not just that we should all think about when children get exposed to certain things, but that parents individually can take it upon
sentences.zh: 所以，这不仅仅是我们都应该考虑孩子何时接触某些事物，而是家长可以个人

sentences.en: themselves to decide what everyone else should learn.
sentences.zh: 承担起决定其他人应该学习什么的责任。

sentences.en: Who gets to decide whose parents' rights are respected?
sentences.zh: 谁来决定谁的家长权利得到尊重？

sentences.en: And so when it comes to the public school, it's got to be the community.
sentences.zh: 所以当涉及到公立学校时，必须是社区。

sentences.en: But which part of the community will?
sentences.zh: 但社区的哪一部分呢？

sentences.en: Well, and that's what makes the school board races so important because there's two competing interests here.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是为什么校董会竞选如此重要的原因，因为这里有两种相互竞争的利益。

sentences.en: Our public schools are going to generally reflect the community values.
sentences.zh: 我们的公立学校通常会反映社区价值观。

sentences.en: So a public school in San Francisco is going to look very different and it's going to teach its public school
sentences.zh: 所以旧金山的公立学校看起来会非常不同，它的公立学校

sentences.en: library, its curriculum is going to look very different than a public school in, let's say,
sentences.zh: 图书馆、它的课程看起来会与德克萨斯州韦科市（Waco）的公立学校

sentences.en: Waco, Texas, because it's going to reflect those community values.
sentences.zh: 非常不同，因为它将反映那些社区价值观。

sentences.en: And I think you raised a very good point of, you know, what about LGBT families?
sentences.zh: 我认为你提出了一个很好的观点，关于LGBT家庭的问题。

sentences.en: A teacher, we give teachers great authority when we send our kids to school.
sentences.zh: 当我们把孩子送到学校时，我们赋予了老师很大的权威。

sentences.en: And so, you know, little Johnny in first grade raises his hand and he's like, what about those people?
sentences.zh: 所以，一年级的小约翰尼举手说，那些人是怎么回事？

sentences.en: And this is a great opportunity for the teacher to say,
sentences.zh: 这对老师来说是一个很好的机会，可以说：

sentences.en: Johnny, there are many different families.
sentences.zh: “约翰尼，有很多不同的家庭。”

sentences.en: They look differently.
sentences.zh: “它们看起来各不相同。”

sentences.en: You know, we love all of these families.
sentences.zh: “你知道，我们爱所有这些家庭。”

sentences.en: This is a great thing to talk about later.
sentences.zh: “这是一个以后再谈的好话题。”

sentences.en: Talk to your parents about this.
sentences.zh: “去和你父母谈谈这个。”

sentences.en: Now let's get back to A, B, and C.
sentences.zh: “现在让我们回到A、B、C。”

sentences.en: But what if little Johnny has two gay parents?
sentences.zh: 但如果小约翰尼有两个同性恋父母呢？

sentences.en: I mean, what if little Johnny wants to be recognized as having his experience of the world valued within the classroom?
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果小约翰尼希望他在课堂内对世界的体验得到认可呢？

sentences.en: I still don't see how HB 1557 would leave that out.
sentences.zh: 我仍然看不出HB 1557法案会如何排除这一点。

sentences.en: And one thing that I think we need to make sure that we recognize is this is why parental involvement in the schools is so important.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们需要确保认识到的一点是，这就是为什么家长参与学校事务如此重要。

sentences.en: So let's say little Johnny has two mommies or little Johnny has two daddies.
sentences.zh: 所以，假设小约翰尼有两个妈妈，或者小约翰尼有两个爸爸。

sentences.en: The parents need to be involved.
sentences.zh: 家长需要参与进来。

sentences.en: They need to be in there meeting the teachers saying, you know, I want to make sure that this classroom is a safe space for little Johnny.
sentences.zh: 他们需要去那里见老师，说，你知道，我想确保这个教室对小约翰尼来说是一个安全的空间。

sentences.en: And we do a disservice to every parent, whether they're gay, straight, heterosexual, whatever.
sentences.zh: 我们对每一位家长都造成了伤害，无论他们是同性恋、异性恋，还是其他任何身份。

sentences.en: If we're saying we don't want you to come in and we leave it up to the teachers to have these these really important and personal discussions where one size is not going
sentences.zh: 如果我们说我们不希望你们介入，而是把这些非常重要且私人的讨论留给老师去处理，而这些讨论并没有一个

sentences.en: to fit all.
sentences.zh: 放之四海而皆准的标准。

sentences.en: But in Waco, Texas, if the culture of the community is overwhelmingly anti-gay, let's say, are you saying that culture needs to win out?
sentences.zh: 但在德克萨斯州的韦科，如果社区文化是压倒性的反同性恋，比方说，你是说那种文化就该胜出吗？

sentences.en: And then do parents who don't fit in
sentences.zh: 那么那些不符合

sentences.en: to that culture need to either fight a losing battle or choose to take their child out of a system that doesn't work for their individual child?
sentences.zh: 那种文化的家长，是需要去打一场注定失败的仗，还是选择让孩子离开一个不适合他们孩子的体系？

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，当然。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 不，绝对不是。

sentences.en: And that's why earlier I said there's two competing interests.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我刚才说存在两种相互竞争的利益。

sentences.en: There is the schools are going to have to look like their community.
sentences.zh: 一方面，学校必须反映其社区的面貌。

sentences.en: But you also have to make sure this goes to that point.
sentences.zh: 但你也要确保这一点能落实到刚才提到的问题上。

sentences.en: But I think it also goes to, you know, what if there's a Republican family in San Francisco or or, you know, a devout
sentences.zh: 但我认为这也涉及到，你知道，如果旧金山有一个共和党家庭，或者，你知道，在纽约市中心有一个虔诚的

sentences.en: Orthodox Jewish family in deep New York City, where we also have to make sure that the schools stay out of some of these hot button issues because there has to be an understanding.
sentences.zh: 正统犹太教家庭，我们也必须确保学校远离这些敏感争议话题，因为必须达成一种共识。

sentences.en: Yes, community values, but also that the role of the public school being funded by the taxpayers is to provide an education, not to provide an indoctrination.
sentences.zh: 是的，社区价值观很重要，但纳税人资助的公立学校的作用是提供教育，而不是提供灌输。

sentences.en: And this cuts both ways, not, you know, reading the Bible sort of thing or reading the Quran or, you know, saying one family is valued above another.
sentences.zh: 这适用于双方，不是说，你知道，读《圣经》或者读《古兰经》，或者，你知道，说一个家庭比另一个家庭更有价值。

sentences.en: But I think we've forgotten that schools should be focusing on the basics.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们忘记了学校应该专注于基础知识。

sentences.en: The school should not replace the family.
sentences.zh: 学校不应该取代家庭。

sentences.en: They should not replace the family's community, whether it's a house of worship or whether it's atheist or whether it's, you know, supporting LGBT pride, for example.
sentences.zh: 它们不应该取代家庭的社区，无论是礼拜场所，还是无神论者，又或者是，你知道，支持LGBT平权，等等。

sentences.en: The school should not be getting into these culture wars.
sentences.zh: 学校不应该卷入这些文化战争。

sentences.en: As we start to wrap up, Will, I want to talk about one of the other hot button issues in the country right now.
sentences.zh: 在我们即将结束时，威尔，我想谈谈目前国内另一个敏感争议话题。

sentences.en: Governor Greg Abbott of Texas's recent mandate that the state investigate parents who seek gender-affirming care for their children as possible child abuse.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州州长格雷格·阿博特最近下令，要求州政府调查那些为子女寻求性别肯定护理的家长，称其可能涉及虐待儿童。

sentences.en: Wouldn't your definition of parents' rights say that the parent of a trans child should be able to choose for themselves what they consider to be the best course of action
sentences.zh: 难道你对家长权利的定义不应该包括：跨性别儿童的家长应该能够自行选择他们认为对孩子而言

sentences.en: on behalf of their child?
sentences.zh: 最好的行动方案吗？

sentences.en: Lulu, I was in a meeting recently with a bunch of organizations, and there was a representative from the Texas attorney general in that meeting.
sentences.zh: 露露，我最近参加了一个有许多组织出席的会议，会上有一位来自德克萨斯州总检察长办公室的代表。

sentences.en: And I spoke up loudly, and I said, you don't go after parents.
sentences.zh: 我大声发言说，你们不能针对家长。

sentences.en: And I think what Texas is responding to in a flawed way is a serious issue.
sentences.zh: 我认为德克萨斯州以一种错误的方式回应了一个严重的问题。

sentences.en: And, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，

sentences.en: New York Times has done some good writing about this.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》对此做了一些很好的报道。

sentences.en: And the issue is, how do you respond to children who are transgender?
sentences.zh: 问题在于，你该如何回应跨性别儿童？

sentences.en: And so I think that was the issue that Governor Abbott was responding to.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这就是阿博特州长试图回应的问题。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, you don't go after parents.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，你不能针对家长。

sentences.en: You have to respect parents.
sentences.zh: 你必须尊重家长。

sentences.en: If there's a legitimate issue that authorities are feeling that some of the care that transgender children
sentences.zh: 如果当局确实认为跨性别儿童所接受的某些护理

sentences.en: are receiving is flawed, then you work with doctors, then you work with the system.
sentences.zh: 存在合理的问题，那么你应该与医生合作，与体制合作。

sentences.en: But you're absolutely right, because parental rights are bigger than, you know, Greg Abbott are bigger than the state of Texas.
sentences.zh: 但你是完全正确的，因为家长权利比，你知道，格雷格·阿博特，比德克萨斯州本身更重要。

sentences.en: They are for all parents.
sentences.zh: 它们属于所有家长。

sentences.en: And at the end of the day, you can't go after parents like that.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，你不能那样针对家长。

sentences.en: So you think that that mandate is at odds with parental rights, as you understand it?
sentences.zh: 所以你认为该行政命令与你所理解的家长权利相抵触？

sentences.en: I think it's at odds with our country's history of parental rights as a fundamental right.
sentences.zh: 我认为它与我国将家长权利视为基本权利的历史相抵触。

sentences.en: And I think that's why Texas has had a series of losses in the courts.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是为什么德克萨斯州在法庭上屡屡败诉的原因。

sentences.en: You know, and Texas courts are fairly conservative.
sentences.zh: 你知道，德克萨斯州的法院相当保守。

sentences.en: I mean, just look at what's going on with some of the abortion issues in Texas.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，看看德克萨斯州在堕胎问题上发生的事情就知道了。

sentences.en: And these same courts are striking down this order because it's well-recognized.
sentences.zh: 而这些同样的法院正在推翻这项命令，因为这是公认的。

sentences.en: We've talked about the line of Supreme Court cases that parental rights are fundamental unless government has
sentences.zh: 我们谈到过一系列最高法院的判例，即家长权利是基本的，除非政府有

sentences.en: a compelling state interest accomplished in the least restrictive means.
sentences.zh: 以限制最少的方式实现的迫切国家利益。

sentences.en: And so if, for example, you're Texas and you think there's issues with the care that transgender children are receiving,
sentences.zh: 所以，例如，如果你是德克萨斯州，并且你认为跨性别儿童接受的护理存在问题，

sentences.en: you don't conduct a child abuse investigation where parents could lose custody of their children,
sentences.zh: 你不应该进行可能导致家长失去子女监护权的虐待儿童调查，

sentences.en: there are lesser restrictive means if Texas feels that this is a compelling state interest and that they can prove it.
sentences.zh: 如果德克萨斯州认为这是一个迫切的国家利益并且能够证明这一点，还有限制更少的手段。

sentences.en: Will, do you expect to see your group coming to the defense of parents of trans children in Texas?
sentences.zh: 威尔，你预计你的组织会站出来为德克萨斯州跨性别儿童的家长辩护吗？

sentences.en: You know, I think the ACLU has done an excellent job in their briefs.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为美国公民自由联盟（ACLU）在他们的法律摘要中做得非常出色。

sentences.en: I've read some of them.
sentences.zh: 我读过其中的一些。

sentences.en: This is an issue that we're aware of.
sentences.zh: 这是一个我们意识到的问题。

sentences.en: We're looking at it.
sentences.zh: 我们正在关注它。

sentences.en: I will also say, though, I mean, this is an issue that is a very partisan issue right now, the issue of dealing with transgender minors.
sentences.zh: 不过，我也想说，我的意思是，这是一个目前非常党派化的问题，即处理跨性别未成年人的问题。

sentences.en: Our organization has tried to kind of avoid the far margins on both right and left.
sentences.zh: 我们的组织一直试图避免左右两翼的极端边缘。

sentences.en: We have not gotten involved in bans on critical race theory, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如，我们没有参与关于禁止批判性种族理论的争论。

sentences.en: We've had a lot of organizations request us.
sentences.zh: 有很多组织请求我们介入。

sentences.en: What we have focused on, however, our curriculum disclosure bills, where
sentences.zh: 然而，我们关注的是课程披露法案，即

sentences.en: bills are passed at the state level saying that parents have the right to know what their children are being taught.
sentences.zh: 在州一级通过法案，规定家长有权知道他们的孩子在学校学什么。

sentences.en: They have the right to opt their children out of certain classes.
sentences.zh: 他们有权让孩子退出某些课程。

sentences.en: So that's one example on the right.
sentences.zh: 所以这是右翼的一个例子。

sentences.en: You know, not yet getting involved legally in the Texas issue is one on the left.
sentences.zh: 你知道，尚未在法律上介入德克萨斯州的问题，这是左翼的一个例子。

sentences.en: Right now, we're focused on more of the bipartisan issues that kind of avoid some of the third rails of the culture wars.
sentences.zh: 目前，我们更专注于那些两党共识的问题，以避开文化战争中的一些雷区。

sentences.en: Will, I want to thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 威尔，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: I appreciate you having this conversation with me.
sentences.zh: 我很感激你能与我进行这次对话。

sentences.en: Lulu, thank you.
sentences.zh: 露露，谢谢你。

sentences.en: This has been a lot of fun.
sentences.zh: 这次谈话非常愉快。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和萨拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《地铁》节目中，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的任何地方收听。
